correctness.rationale: For triangle-free H, every face of CF3(K_m∨H) is either an arbitrary H-vertex set, one hub plus an independent H-set, or two hubs alone. This proves a literal simplicial equality Delta_R union (D_m * Ind(H)) plus binom(m,2) unfilled hub edges; connected Ind(H) ensures the suspended core is simply connected. Nullhomotopy of Ind(H) -> Delta_R by the simplex barycenter is Aut(H)-equivariant; the cofiber is D_{m+1}*Ind(H) = wedge^m ΣInd(H). Adding each hub-hub edge contributes an independent free S1, giving π1 free rank binom(m,2). Relative chain complexes and signed orientation of hub edges yield H1=∧² Z^m and degree>=2 shifted permutation-lattice tensor. Examined exact source and verify_clique_join.py at immutable tree; independently checked direct face counts m=3,H=C5 (68) and C6 (121) including their independence sets (11 and18). General statement follows symbolic pushout, not finite tests.
